```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

```{r library}
library(data.table)
library(here)
library(tictoc)
library(stringr)
```

```{r parameters}
year_to_load <- "2018"
path_to_raw_claims <- "data-cleaning/raw_claims/"
path_to_intermediate <- "data-cleaning/intermediate_claims/"

# Define column types
character_cols <- c("PSEUDO_CLAIMSERIES", "PSEUDO_MEM_PIN", "HCI_PMCC_NO",
                    "HCP_NO_LIST", "PRIMARY_ILLNESS", "SECONDARY_ILLNESS",
                    paste0("ICDCODE", c(1:14, 16:170)), "ICCODED15",
                    paste0("RVSCODE", 1:20), "DATE_ADM", "TIME_ADM",
                    "DATE_DIS", "TIME_DIS", "DATE_REC", "DATE_REF", 
                    "CHKDT", "PAT_BDAY", "EXTRACTION_DATE")
integer_cols = c("OUT_PATIENT", "EMERGENCY")
factor_cols = c("PATIENT_TYPE", "ROOM_TYPE", "DEP_REL", "PATSEX", 
                "MEMCAT_PARENT_DESC", "MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC", 
                "MEMCAT_SUBCHILD_DESC", "DISPOSITION", "CLAIMS_STATUS")
numeric_cols = c("PATAGE", "PAT_BWT_KG", "CLAIMS_PAID_AMT", 
                 "ACR_AMOUNT_ACTUAL")
na_values <- c('NONE','None','-','--','---','N/A','n/a','nan','NAN') 
na_like_strings <- c("", " ", "  ", "-", "none", "None", "NONE", "NA", "n/a", "N/A", "NaN", "'", "\t", "\n", "\r", "\f", "\v", "\u00A0", "\u2000", "\u2001", "\u2002", "\u2003", "\u2004", "\u2005", "\u2006", "\u2007", "\u2008", "\u2009", "\u200A", "\u2028", "\u2029", "\u202F", "\u205F", "\u3000")

# Columns to drop (based on indexes)
drop_cols <- 76:196
```

```{r process full dataset}
# Step 1: Read the entire dataset
tic("Reading full dataset")
df <- fread(here(paste0(path_to_raw_claims, "claims_extract_CLAIMS_", year_to_load, ".csv")),
            na.strings = na_values)
toc()

# Step 2: Drop unnecessary columns
cols_to_keep <- setdiff(seq_along(df), drop_cols)
df <- df[, ..cols_to_keep]

# Step 3: Identify columns that can be dropped (all NA or na_like_strings)
droppable_cols <- sapply(df, function(col) all(is.na(col) | col %in% na_like_strings))
df <- df[, !droppable_cols, with = FALSE]

# Step 4: Rename columns
setnames(df, colnames(df))

# Step 5: Add a column id_year and set its value to the variable year_to_load
df[, id_year := as.integer(year_to_load)]

# Step 6: Update columns as per your processing steps
df[, PATIENT_TYPE := fcase(
  PATIENT_TYPE == "MEMBER", "MEM",
  PATIENT_TYPE == "DEPENDENT", "DEP"
)]

df[, MEMCAT_PARENT_DESC := fcase(
  MEMCAT_PARENT_DESC == "DIRECT CONTRIBUTOR", "DIRECT",
  MEMCAT_PARENT_DESC == "INDIRECT CONTRIBUTOR", "INDIRECT"
)]

df[, MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC := fcase(
  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "EMPLOYED PRIVATE", "FORMAL",
  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "SELF-EARNING INDIVIDUAL", "INFORMAL",
  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "SENIOR CITIZEN", "SENIOR",
  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "INDIGENT", "INDIGENT",
  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "LIFETIME MEMBER", "LIFETIME",
  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "SPONSORED", "SPONSORED",
  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "MIGRANT WORKER", "INFORMAL",
  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "EMPLOYED GOVERNMENT", "FORMAL",
  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "INFORMAL ECONOMY", "INFORMAL",
  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "HOUSEHOLD HELP/KASAMBAHAY", "FORMAL",
  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "FOREIGN NATIONAL", "INFORMAL",
  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "FILIPINOS WITH DUAL CITIZENSHIP / LIVING ABROAD", "INFORMAL",
  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "SELF EARNING INDIVIDUAL", "INFORMAL",
  MEMCAT_CHILD_DESC == "FAMILY DRIVER", "FORMAL"
)]

df[, DISPOSITION := fcase(
  DISPOSITION == "IMPROVED", 1L,
  DISPOSITION == "RECOVERED", 1L,
  DISPOSITION == "HOME/DISCHARGED AGAINST MEDICAL ADVICE", 2L,
  DISPOSITION == "ABSCONDED", 3L,
  DISPOSITION == "TRANSFERRED/REFERRED", 4L,
  DISPOSITION == "EXPIRED", 9L,
  DISPOSITION == "UNDEFINED", NA_integer_
)]

# Step 7: Process and collapse ICD and RVS columns
icd_cols <- intersect(colnames(df), c(paste0("ICDCODE", c(1:14, 16:170)), "ICCODED15"))
rvs_cols <- intersect(colnames(df), paste0("RVSCODE", 1:20))

process_and_collapse_columns <- function(df, cols_to_process, new_col_name) {
  for (col in cols_to_process) {
    set(df, j = col, value = iconv(df[[col]], to = "UTF-8", sub = "byte"))
    set(df, j = col, value = toupper(df[[col]]))
    set(df, j = col, value = str_trim(df[[col]]))
    set(df, j = col, value = str_replace_all(df[[col]], " ", ""))
    set(df, j = col, value = str_replace_all(df[[col]], "\n", ""))
    set(df, j = col, value = str_replace_all(df[[col]], "[^\\w\\d\\/\\s]+", ""))
    set(df, j = col, value = ifelse(df[[col]] %in% na_like_strings, NA_character_, df[[col]]))
  }

  df[, (new_col_name) := do.call(paste, c(.SD, sep = "||")), .SDcols = cols_to_process]
  df[, (new_col_name) := str_replace_all(get(new_col_name), "\\|\\|NA", "")]
  df[, (new_col_name) := str_replace_all(get(new_col_name), "NA\\|\\|", "")]
  df[, (new_col_name) := str_replace_all(get(new_col_name), "\\|\\|$", "")]
  df[, (new_col_name) := ifelse(get(new_col_name) == "NA", NA_character_, get(new_col_name))]

  df[, (cols_to_process) := NULL]
}

tic("Processing ICD columns")
process_and_collapse_columns(df, icd_cols, "clin_icd")
toc()

tic("Processing RVS columns")
process_and_collapse_columns(df, rvs_cols, "clin_rvs")
toc()

# Step 8: Export the cleaned data to a CSV file
output_file <- here("data-cleaning/cleaned_claims", paste0("cleaned_claims_extract_CLAIMS_", year_to_load, ".csv"))

tic("Writing cleaned data to CSV")
fwrite(df, output_file)
toc()
```
